cells.reason: Multiple passages directly address Schwab's preparedness for generational wealth transfer, including a wealth-transfer retention rate, younger client attraction, and estate/tax planning tools.

items.text: Schwab reports that approximately 75% of assets are retained in a wealth transfer event.
items.quote: ~75% Assets Retained in a Wealth Transfer Event
items.unit: of assets retained in a wealth transfer event

items.text: Schwab reports that approximately 70% of new-to-firm retail households are Gen Z and Millennials.
items.quote: ~70% NTF Retail HH are Gen Z & Millennials
items.unit: of new-to-firm retail households (Gen Z & Millennials)

items.text: Schwab reports that 80% of retail assets are held by ultra-high net worth and high net worth households.
items.quote: 80% Retail Assets Held by U/HNW HHs
items.unit: of retail assets held by ultra-high net worth and high net worth households

items.text: Schwab's CEO states its retail business is built to win across generations and that its retention rate around wealth transfers is extremely high, with the firm well positioned to continue serving future generations when that wealth is passed on.
items.quote: Our retail business is built to win across generations, wealth tiers, investing styles and engagement preferences... Roughly 80% of retail assets are held by ultra-high net worth and high net worth households, and we are well positioned to continue serving future generations when that wealth is passed on. Our retention rate around wealth transfers is extremely high, and we are winning assets with all generations.

items.text: Schwab's CEO states that approximately 70% of new-to-firm retail households are Gen Z and millennials.
items.quote: We are attracting younger clients, approximately 70% of new-to-firm retail households are Gen Z and millennials.
items.unit: of new-to-firm retail households (Gen Z and millennials)

items.text: Schwab's CEO states that the average age of its clients has fallen by about 10 years over the last decade and that a third of new-to-firm clients in 2025 were Gen Z investors.
items.quote: Our average age of our client has fallen by about 10 years in the last decade and is now in the 40s. A third of our new-to-firm clients last year were Gen Z investors

items.text: Schwab took an ownership stake in Wealth.com and began rolling out their estate analysis capability, giving it more tools to help clients integrate estate planning into their investment life.
items.quote: We took an ownership stake in Wealth.com and began rolling out their estate analysis capability to our specialists, giving us more tools to help clients integrate their estate planning into their investment life.

items.text: Schwab launched the Schwab Teen Investor account for young people ages 13 to 17 to get started on their investing journey, part of attracting the next generation.
items.quote: We launched the Schwab Teen Investor account, giving young people ages 13 to 17 an engaging way to get started on their lifelong investing journey.

items.text: Schwab's CEO states the average age of its clients continues to get younger and that one-third of retail households who created a financial plan within the last two years are under age 40.
items.quote: While client assets are more concentrated among older generations today, the average age of our clients continues to get younger... one-third of retail households who created a financial plan within the last two years are under the age of 40.
